# Mochi evolution artwork

Generated with the built-in image_gen tool, with a transparent background. The production asset is `cats/evolution-atlas.webp`; lossless alpha was retained while encoding the generated PNG as WebP. The renderer frames each character directly from this atlas without a photo background or opacity fade.

## Generation brief

One production sprite atlas, portrait 3:4, with eleven full-body orange tabby cat evolution characters arranged in a 3-column, 4-row grid, and an empty final cell. True transparency; no text, borders, scenery, or gridlines. Consistent premium soft 3D collectible-toy rendering, orange forehead stripes, cream muzzles, warm amber eyes, sculpted fluffy fur, expressive faces, and visible paws. Distinct silhouettes readable at mobile tile size.

Row-major stages: curled newborn kitten; wide-eyed sitting baby with pink paw pads; playful fluffy kitten with raised tail; confident longer-bodied adolescent; luxurious fluffy adult; round happy chonk; spherical startled mega-loaf; enormous lounging belly-up cat; majestic lion-maned giant house cat; round Cat King with gold crown and purple velvet cape; floating celestial Cat God retaining orange fur, with pastel star halo and tiny planets. Characters remain isolated, fully inside their frame, with no overlap.

## Game mapping

2 Tiny Bean → 4 Baby Mochi → 8 Pocket Floof → 16 Little Menace → 32 Fluff Supreme → 64 Certified Chonk → 128 Mega Loaf → 256 Absolute Unit → 512 Lord of the Floof → 1024 His Meowjesty → 2048 Cosmic Mochi.

Discoveries are stored locally on the player's device. They persist across restarts and undo, while the current run's pet spotlight tracks its highest growth stage.
